verdict.rationale: A community-posted log excerpt shows Ollama's own output explaining a GPU fallback: it detected an AMD GPU, found no compatible ROCm library, and said it would use the CPU. So the product does emit a reason when acceleration fails. That is a single AMD/ROCm instance from a community post, with no first-party documentation of diagnostics, so the depth and consistency of this output is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party docs on GPU-detection and fallback logging, evidence of diagnostics for NVIDIA/Metal and other failure modes, guidance on where to find or how to surface these messages, and independent corroboration that the output is clear rather than buried in server logs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output

citations.quote: amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... unable to verify rocm library, will use cpu: no suitable rocm found, falling back to CPU.
